models_evaluated: LLM with k-nearest-neighbor few-shot prompting (model not named in text)

links.outcome: Blinded physician ratings of LLM vs physician-authored ED one-liner summaries on accuracy, completeness, utility
links.effect: LLM summaries rated higher: accuracy 4.18 vs 3.40 (β=0.78; 95% CI 0.50-1.07); completeness 3.69 vs 3.25 (β=0.44); clinical utility 3.88 vs 3.21 (β=0.67).
links.quote: We found that across all dimensions, LLM-generated summaries received higher ratings than physician-authored summaries.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval of selected EHR notes via k-nearest-neighbor few-shot prompting for summarization

screen.reason: Blinded evaluation study comparing LLM-generated vs physician-authored clinical one-liner summaries for emergency department encounters across accuracy, completeness, and utility.
